verdict.rationale: Slack's official Web API documents sending messages to a channel (chat.postMessage). The official MCP server lets an agent retrieve and send messages, and the Web API spec covers user and bot-user token usage. However, the evidence never documents OAuth scopes or permission granularity for those tokens, so the 'scoped tokens' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OAuth scopes and least-privilege token configuration, a cited channel-history read method in the Web API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent reading and posting.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent read and post channel messages through the official API using scoped tokens
